info.title: API.SH: Grekodom
info.description: The Grekodom API from API.SH: public Grekodom data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
An area page: its title, the area guide (sections with headings and text) and the area's listings, 15 a page in the site's order. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/grekodom-area

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Area id (from /grekodom/v1/regions or a property's area_path, e.g. 6 for Crete) or an /area/<id> link.

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Language of the site's text: en (default), el, de, ru, fr, nl, pl, tr, bg, sr, uk, ka, hy or ar. Listing ids are the same in every language.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Every listing that matches a search, without paging (the whole result set the site shows on its map): id, link, price, latitude, longitude and type group, plus the exact total. Same filters as /grekodom/v1/search (language does not apply). Use /grekodom/v1/cards or /grekodom/v1/property for details.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/grekodom-map

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Property types, comma-separated: flat, duplex, maisonette, detached_house, villa, hotel, business, commercial_property, building, complex, land, island, or the groups housing, commercial, lands (the site's type ids also work). Default: every type.

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: Up to 5 regions, comma-separated: ids from /grekodom/v1/regions (e.g. 6 for Crete, 196 for Chalkidiki) or place names (the site's first match is used and returned in `regions_resolved`).

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: recommended (default), popular, price_asc, price_desc, newest, size_asc or size_desc.

parameters.name: min_year
parameters.description: Built in or after this year.

parameters.name: max_year
parameters.description: Built in or before this year.

parameters.name: min_floor
parameters.description: Lowest floor: basement, ground, entresol, 1-8, last, attic or upper.

parameters.name: max_sea_distance
parameters.description: Maximum distance from the sea, metres.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Instead of (or with) the params above: a grekodom search link (…/RealtyObjects?…, /area/<id> or /Cyprus); its filters are used and the params above override them.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Return at most this many listings (the total is still the full count).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
